Version 2 is a rewrite for ESLint 9 flat config. The 1.x line stays on npm as `@conarti/eslint-plugin-feature-sliced@1` for projects that are still on ESLint 8 or on a legacy `.eslintrc` file.

```sh
npm i -D eslint @conarti/eslint-plugin-feature-sliced
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
import featureSliced from '@conarti/eslint-plugin-feature-sliced';

export default [
  featureSliced(),
];
```

## Breaking changes

* ESLint 9 or newer is required, flat config only. Node.js 18.18 or newer.
* The default export is a factory. `featureSliced()` returns one flat-config object with the plugin, its settings and all rules. The `configs` export (`recommended`, `rules`) and the `./import-order` subpath are removed; the `sortImports` option selects one of the same four sorting presets.
* `eslint-plugin-import` is no longer needed. The sorting preset is built on `eslint-plugin-import-x`, which ships as a dependency, and the rule id is `@conarti/feature-sliced/import-order`.
* Rule options renamed: `ignorePatterns` is now `ignoreImports`, `ignoreInFilesPatterns` is now `ignoreFiles`.
* The new rule `no-cross-segment-reexport` is enabled by default at `error`.
* A cross-layer import whose target slice has the same name as the current one is now reported by `layers-slices` and `public-api`. 1.x skipped it (#18), so a project that reuses a slice name across layers, such as `pages/orders` importing `entities/orders/api`, will see new errors after upgrading.

## New

* `layers` option: a custom layer hierarchy, with `hasSlices` per layer. Every rule and the sorting preset follow it.
* `segments` option: extend or replace the default segment names. With `publicApi: { level: 'segments' }` an unconfigured segment in an import path is reported.
* `severity` option that sets all FSD rules at once, a per-rule `severity` on top, and `false` to turn any rule off.
* `@x` cross-imports between entities are understood by `layers-slices`, `absolute-relative` and `public-api`.
* `ignoreImports` and `ignoreFiles` are available on all four FSD rules.
* `require('@conarti/eslint-plugin-feature-sliced')` returns the factory, so CommonJS configs work without `.default`.

## Fixes

* `layers-slices`: no false positive when a segment directly follows a layer without slices, and the message names the configured layer order.
* `public-api`: suggestions no longer keep the file extension (#17), and `@x` paths are skipped by the unknown segment check.

## Known limitations

* `absolute-relative` and `no-cross-segment-reexport` do not read the `segments` option yet (#37, #35).
* `layers-slices` misses a default import combined with inline type specifiers only (#38).
* The layer-level `index` check of `public-api` does not fire under a directory whose name starts with a dot (#34).

## Migration

The README maps every 1.x setting to its 2.x equivalent: https://github.com/conarti/eslint-plugin-feature-sliced#migrating-from-1x
